postings.title: Senior Product Engineer
postings.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

This is a full-stack product role with a backend-heavy centre of gravity. You'll own complete product slices end-to-end — things like a candidate database with rich search and filtering, a dashboard that surfaces call transcripts and match history for our Talent Operations team, and the workflows that let them stack-rank candidates against a new role in minutes rather than hours. You ship these without needing to be guided step by step.

You're not a specialist who hands off at the API boundary. You think in user outcomes and delivery units, and you're reliable: your code handles edge cases, your APIs have clean contracts, and the work you ship stays shipped.



What You'll Do

 - Own product delivery — take features from spec to production, backend-first but covering frontend and integration where needed

 - Build and maintain backend systems — product APIs, data pipelines, and core infrastructure on our Python/FastAPI/Postgres stack

 - Build with LLMs and agents — ship product features with significant LLM integration; contribute to the voice agent backend and information extraction systems

 - Work across the stack — ship workable React/TypeScript frontend for product features; not a frontend specialist, but comfortable and pragmatic

 - Collaborate with product and design — translate ambiguous requirements into concrete shipped work; be the engineer who unblocks, not the one who waits

 - Maintain quality at speed — handle data integrity, error paths, API evolution, and operational concerns as a default, not an afterthought



What We're Looking For

 - Independent delivery - You can own and ship end-to-end product slices with minimal supervision; your track record shows features that shipped, stuck, and scaled

 - Product trade-off judgment — you balance speed, quality, and user impact under ambiguity; you push back when something is underspecified and make pragmatic calls when it needs to ship

 - Reliability and API discipline — you handle data integrity, error paths, idempotence, and API versioning as standard practice; production reliability is your default, not a later concern

 - Cross-functional pragmatism — you work effectively with product and design, can unblock yourself across the stack, and ship workable frontend when that's what's needed



Strong technical depth in:

 - Python backend (FastAPI or equivalent, async patterns, Postgres, Redis)

 - LLM integration — building products where AI is in the critical path, not bolted on

 - API design and data modelling

 - JavaScript/TypeScript — comfortable enough to ship frontend features and review frontend PRs

Nice to Have

 - Experience with voice agents or real-time audio pipelines

 - Familiarity with evals, guardrails, or agent observability

 - Familiarity with GCP / cloud infrastructure

 - Experience in recruiting tech, marketplaces, or matching systems



The Stack

A modern Python stack: FastAPI, Postgres, Redis, Docker, Pydantic AI, running on GCP. Frontend in React/TypeScript. We iterate fast and keep the codebase clean.

What We Offer

 - Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

 - Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

 - Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

 - Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

 - Gym membership & wellness benefits

 - Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

 - Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

 - MacBook Pro + team kit

 - "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

 1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback. 

 2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

 3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

 4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

 5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

postings.description:
Our Mission

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

The AI startups and scaleups we work with have roles they can’t fill. Not because they haven’t tried, but because they have world-class hiring bars, and it’s genuinely tough.

As a Talent Partner, you own those client relationships end to end. You take a role brief properly, you push back when it doesn’t add up, and you become the person a founder, internal talent partner or hiring manager calls before they’ve even decided to hire. You also own delivery, making sure every client has an amazing experience using Dex, from brief through to signed offer.

We’re an AI-first company, and our talent team is pushing the boundaries of what AI can do in recruitment. You won’t just be using AI tools, you’ll be part of the team working out what great hiring looks like when AI is built into every step.

You’ll also shape the product. You’ll work directly with our product and engineering teams, who are building tools specifically for you. When something isn’t working, whether it’s a match that shouldn’t have reached you or a workflow that slows you down, you raise it with the people who can fix it, and you see it change. Talent Partners are brought in early on anything that touches their workflow, so you help decide what gets built, not just use it.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own a portfolio of client relationships end to end: brief, delivery, feedback, and everything after

 - Take role briefs and kick-offs that actually hold up. Scope the role, interrogate the requirements, and tell a client when the role is really two roles, or shouldn’t be hired at all

 - Run the process on the client side: keep feedback fast, keep interviews moving, and keep momentum from breaking

 - Use funnel data to diagnose stalling roles and walk clients through where they’re losing people and why

 - Negotiate and close offers so that neither side feels managed

 - Grow accounts from one search into the whole hiring plan


YOU’LL PROBABLY HAVE

 - 2+ years in tech or engineering recruitment, either in-house at a startup or scaleup or at a specialist tech agency

 - Hired for roles like backend, infra, ML/AI engineers, researchers or founding engineers, and the ability to hold a credible conversation with a CTO about what a role really needs

 - Strong command of funnel metrics: you know what good conversion looks like at each stage and what to do when it isn’t happening

 - Commercial sharpness and the confidence to push back on senior people early, rather than having the expensive conversation late

 - Curiosity about AI tooling. You’ll be a daily power user of a product that’s being built around you


WHY JOIN NOW

You’ll be building relationships with some of the best AI startups and scaleups on the planet, helping them hire the roles they care most about. You’ll have experienced talent leaders around you day to day, and a product team building tools for you specifically. This is a team that deeply understands how difficult and how important hiring is.

We’re open on backgrounds. If you have the raw ingredients and have excelled where you are now, we want to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Above market base salary plus uncapped commission; we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

 - Significant equity - we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

 - Full private healthcare & dental - because life happens and we want to support you

 - Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

 - Gym membership & wellness benefits

 - Claude tokens - lots and lots of Claude tokens

 - Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

 - MacBook Pro + team kit

 - "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support
   
   


THE PROCESS

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and respectful of your time. Here's what you can expect:

 - Talent Screen: Becca (Head of Talent) 30m

 - Hiring Manager Interview: Richard, who heads up Talent Operations at Dex (30-45m)

 - Short Take Home Exercise

 - Task Review (60m)

 - In person interview
   
   - Culture Fit & Values (45m)
   
   - Final Interview with Paddy, CEO and Founder at Dex (30m)

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Dex has something to say. Your job is to make it famous.

As Content Lead, you’ll write and publish everything that carries our name. You’ll own Dex’s channels: the website, social, email and blog. You’ll take our brand strategy and build it into a high-quality, far-reaching engine.

This is a job for someone who writes well and fast, but the words are just the start. Or more accurately the end. You’ll decide which ideas we push and where they land, until the engineers and companies we want to reach know what Dex stands for before they’ve ever used it.

This isn’t a job for someone who waits for a brief. It’s for someone who can understand where our audiences are, how to get them to notice us, and what we need to say to get shared.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, Design and Product.

You'll have real autonomy and very little bureaucracy.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the channels. The publishing calendar across site, social, email and the blog is yours. You decide what runs, when, and in what order.

 - Write across every format. LinkedIn and X posts, campaign and event emails, landing pages, product and lifecycle copy, event pages and follow-ups, articles and explainers. A 90-word post and a 1,500-word essay in the same afternoon, both sounding like us.

 - Think in distribution, not just drafts. Every piece gets planned around where it will be read: why a piece lands on Hacker News and dies on LinkedIn, which newsletters and communities our audience already trusts.

 - Write for search and AI answers. We have a GEO and SEO spec built with our search partner: answer-first structure, extractable formatting, clean internal linking, author entity pages. You'll write to it and help us improve it.

 - Carry the events programme. Copy and collateral for our event series, before, during and after, and the follow-up sequences that turn attendance into something.

 - Work the numbers. Track performance and report back on the metrics that matter across our owned blog and organic social media channels.

 - Use AI properly. Research, outlining, structuring, first passes, repurposing, quality checks. We'll give you all the Claude tokens you can use. We will not ship anything that sounds like AI wrote it, and we'll ask you how you draw that line.

 - Guard the voice. You'll be the most frequent user of our tone of voice and audience research, and the person most responsible for whether it holds up in public.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years writing in-house or at an agency, ideally for a technical or developer audience, ideally in a start-up where you had to build the process as well as the output

 - Genuine range across formats and lengths, evidenced by a portfolio of published work

 - A real view on distribution: where our audience discovers, consumes and shares things, and what a piece needs to look like to survive that journey

 - Working knowledge of SEO and how AI search surfaces content, enough to write to a spec and challenge it

 - Fluent with AI tools across research, outlining and iteration, with judgement about where the machine stops and you start

 - Commercial literacy. You can connect a piece of content to an outcome and look beyond vanity metrics

 - Editorial judgement. You can take a rough steer and come back with something better than the brief

 - A proactive communicator who works well without supervision and asks for what they need


NICE TO HAVE

 - Any technical background, formal or self-taught

 - You've run a newsletter, blog or publication of your own

 - Experience marketing to engineers, developers or another audience that punishes fluff

 - Experience with content for events and communities

 - Basic design or motion skills, enough to get a social asset out without waiting


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Above-market salary — we're building a world-class team and believe pay should match that ambition

 - Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

 - Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

 - Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

 - Gym membership & wellness benefits

 - Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

 - Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

 - MacBook Pro + team kit

 - "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support



INTERVIEW PROCESS

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

 1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we’d love to hear your feedback.

 2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

 3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

 4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

 5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our founder, Paddy.

postings.title: Performance Marketing Manager
postings.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.


THE ROLE

Paid acquisition is one of the biggest levers we have on growth, and it's about to get a lot bigger. We run Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta today, we're adding new formats and channels, and over the next year we'll be running paid across more markets and across both sides of Dex: the engineers who use it and the companies who hire through it.

You'll own our paid channels day to day. You'll decide where the money goes, launch and test campaigns quickly, and judge every channel on the quality of the people it brings in, not on clicks or cheap signups. Creative comes from our in-house creative lead, writers and UGC creators; your job is to brief them well, test what they make and scale what works.

This isn't a role where you sit in the ad accounts all week. Once the channels are running well, we want you to take on more: client-side acquisition, new channels, and building your own tools with AI to do the job faster.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta: structure, budgets, bidding, audiences and day-to-day optimisation.

 - Launch new campaigns in days, not weeks. Run a steady programme of tests across audiences, formats and landing pages.

 - Judge channels on what matters to Dex: good candidates and the ones who get put forward to clients. Work with our data to make sure conversion tracking and attribution are right, and push quality signals back into the platforms.

 - Brief creative. Work with our creative lead, writers and UGC creators on what to make, tell them what's working and kill what isn't.

 - Open up new channels as we grow, such as YouTube, Performance Max, retargeting and new markets.

 - Help take paid into client acquisition: getting Dex in front of heads of talent, engineering leaders and founders.

 - Manage our paid media agency and any contractors, and bring more of the work in-house over time.

 - Report clearly on spend and results each week, and say plainly what you'd change.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands on in performance marketing, managing real budgets yourself across paid search and paid social. Meta and LinkedIn experience matters most.

 - You've worked at a tech company, or you're ready for your first in-house role after a couple of years at a strong agency.

 - You care about what happens after the click. You've optimised for downstream quality, not just cost per lead, and you know how to set up tracking that you trust.

 - Comfortable with data. You can pull your own numbers, spot when something looks wrong, and explain what's going on without a dashboard doing it for you.

 - You move fast and like owning things. You'd rather ship a test today than plan it for a week.

 - You use AI tools daily, and you're happy building small tools, scripts or agents to do your job better. You don't need to be an engineer.



Strong nice-to-haves

 - You've run performance marketing for both consumer (B2C) and business (B2B) audiences, ideally at more than one tech company.

 - You've worked closely with a creative studio or run UGC at volume, so you know what a good brief looks like.

If you don't tick every box but this sounds like you, apply anyway.




WHY JOIN NOW

 - You'll own a channel mix that's growing fast, with the budget and freedom to try things.

 - You'll work on a product people care about. Changing jobs is one of the biggest decisions engineers make, and we want them to trust us with it.

 - You'll work closely with the founders and the Head of Growth, with a lot of room to grow your scope.

 - Everyone here builds with AI. You'll have the tools and the time to work that way.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Above-market salary

 - Significant equity

 - Private healthcare and dental

 - Fertility benefits and enhanced parental support

 - Gym membership and wellness benefits

 - Claude tokens

 - Regular socials, offsites and an annual team trip

 - MacBook Pro and team equipment

 - A "whatever you need" approach to tools and support




THE PROCESS

 1. Talent screen with Becca, Head of Talent (30 min)

 2. Hiring manager interview with Rob, Head of Growth (45 min)

 3. Practical task: a short paid acquisition audit and plan, done at home

 4. In person: task review with Rob and the growth team (60 min), culture and values (45 min), final interview with Paddy, CEO and founder (30 min)
